lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
Did you see someone suspicious in the vicinity?
Suspicious…? I… I don't know. It was dark, and I was only there for a moment. I just… found him and called. That's all.
Midnight… I think. Around midnight, when I called you. Why? Does… does the time matter?

…Before midnight. Okay. I was there earlier. Around ten fifty… I was on the bridge, and I heard something. A tiny, high-pitched bell, from under it. Then someone walked away along the riverbank. They had a dark umbrella. I couldn't see their face… I was too scared to move, so I hid for an hour before I went down. I'm sorry I lied…
It didn't have to come to this if you were not lying
…I know. I'm sorry, Detective. I was scared. A person who maybe just… walked away from a murder. What would you have done…? But I'll tell you everything else. I promise.
Presents: Ink on the Victim’s Palm
A… seven, and a three? …I don't know what that could mean. I never spoke to Ishida-sen— I mean, the victim. I didn't… we didn't talk. I'm sorry, I can't help with numbers like that.

Seiran… that's my school. But… class 2-B? I'm in 2-A, that's not… I don't know this page. …Detective, there's something I have to tell you. I knew him. Ishida-sensei was my maths tutor — he gave me private lessons at his home, for free, because my family can't afford cram school. It's forbidden at Seiran, so I kept it secret. That night I was supposed to have a lesson at ten, but at 21:40 he texted me: 'Sorry, Yuki. Cancel tonight. Someone from the old days wants to talk.' It felt wrong, so I went toward his house… over the bridge. I'll show you the message.
